messages:
Olivia A: Heads-up — OrbitCare exec just sent over last-minute telemetry & billing constraints. POC kickoff scheduled for tomorrow 11am PT, we need unblock.
Rahul P: copying @liam_g and @mara_cs. what are the exact asks?
Olivia A: three items: 1) private telemetry stream (no public ingest), 2) a hard per-token billing cap for POC, 3) 7-day raw log retention then delete. They also want a signed note that costs won't exceed cap.
Liam G: private stream is fine via VPC peering + s3 presigned URLs. need security signoff for S3 bucket policy.
Mara CS: legal asked for the signed note template — can we provide a temporary cap attestation?
Rahul P: we can do a billing cap with guardrail in our routing layer, and send CSV export daily. Need estimates: expected TPS and token rate.
Olivia A: customer expects ~10 RPS, avg 80 tokens/response, spikes to 50RPS for 10m. They want cap at $5k/mo for POC.
Liam G: quick config I can propose:
```
telemetry: vpc-forwarder -> s3://redwood-orbitcare-telemetry
retention_days: 7
billing_cap: 5000
alerts: email -> ops@orbitcare
```
Liam G: security will need to approve bucket policy + KMS key usage. tagging ops ticket now.
ops-bot: created ticket OPS-1248 for 'OrbitCare POC telemetry access' assigned to liam_g.
Mara CS: I can draft the attestation. rahul, can you confirm we can enforce cap and auto-throttle at app layer so we never bill past $5k?
Rahul P: yes — we'll implement token-metering + throttle; if cap hit then fallback to small model (or 429). I'll scope change now and ping infra.
Olivia A: timeline? we need signoff before 10am PT tomorrow.
Liam G: I'll fast-track security review, but need the exact bucket policy and KMS ARN from the customer.
Olivia A: pinged OrbitCare to provide KMS ARN and confirmation for peering. Link to their request: https://orbitcare.com/poc/telemetry-request
Mara CS: attaching draft attestation in drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/attestations/orbitcare-draft.docx
Rahul P: rolling a short fallback plan: if we reach cap, route to gpt-small-quantized to keep UX alive. Need SRE to approve model variant.
SRE oncall (no-reply): SRE acked model fallback; add runbook entry for throttling behavior.
Olivia A: thanks team — @liam_g please update OPS-1248 with ETA, @mara_cs share final attestation once ready. :thumbsup:
Mara CS: will send by 08:30 PT.
Liam G: ETA 07:45 PT for security signoff (contingent on KMS ARN).
